description: Create ABAP Unit tests for a CDS view: check the view supports CDS test doubles, create a test class holding the local test classes, activate it.

cds_view_name.description: CDS view under test (DDL source). Must be active and testable with test doubles.

class_name.description: Name of the new global class that holds the tests.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

package_name.description: Package of the new test class.

test_class_source.description: ABAP source of the local test classes: definitions and implementations, FOR TESTING.

transport_request.description: Transport request, not a task. Required for a transportable package.

name: CreateCdsUnitTest
